title: Virtual Care Session Technology Standard: Reconnection, Phone Fallback, Escalation and Recording
content:
Five session settings apply to every Virtual Care visit type: the connected-minutes threshold for a session ended by a technical failure, the number of reconnection attempts after a dropped session, whether a dropped video session may be finished by phone, whether the clinician may escalate the encounter to video without a new charge, and whether the session may be recorded.

## Definitions

- **Technical-failure threshold** — the number of connected minutes below which a session ended by a technical failure is not charged.
- **Reconnection attempts** — the number of reconnection attempts the clinician makes after a dropped session before switching to phone.
- **Phone fallback** — whether a dropped video session may be completed by phone as the same encounter (yes or no).
- **Escalation to video** — whether the clinician may escalate the encounter to a video visit without a new charge (yes or no).
- **Recording** — whether the session may be recorded. For clinical privacy this setting is No on every visit type.

## Settings by visit type

| Visit type | Technical-failure threshold | Reconnection attempts | Phone fallback | Escalation to video | Recording |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | 0 minutes | 0 | No | Yes | No |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | 5 minutes | 2 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Primary Care Video Visit | 8 minutes | 2 | Yes | No | No |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 20 minutes | 3 | Yes | No | No |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | 10 minutes | 2 | Yes | No | No |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | 5 minutes | 2 | Yes | No | No |

## The threshold read on both sides

A session with fewer connected minutes than the threshold is below it; a session with exactly the threshold, or more, is not below it. Worked from the table with example connected times:

| Visit type | Threshold | Example below the threshold | Example not below the threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | 5 minutes | 4 connected minutes | 5 connected minutes |
| Primary Care Video Visit | 8 minutes | 7 connected minutes | 8 connected minutes |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 20 minutes | 19 connected minutes | 20 connected minutes |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | 10 minutes | 9 connected minutes | 10 connected minutes |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | 5 minutes | 4 connected minutes | 5 connected minutes |

For the Portal E-Visit the threshold is 0 minutes, so no connected time falls below it.

## Notes

- The Behavioral Health Video Visit is the one visit type with 3 reconnection attempts; the Portal E-Visit has none, and every other visit type has 2.
- Escalation to video without a new charge is available on the Portal E-Visit and the Audio-Only Phone Visit only.
- The Portal E-Visit is the one visit type without phone fallback.
